acceptanceCriteria: Each named test is reproduced under N CPU burners with BASE vs fixed counts at the same load, or refuted with counts.
Reproduced ones use the existing sweepObservationBoundKey seam or a new test-only seam for the supervisor drain bound, leaving product bounds unchanged; one mutation per fix brings the failure back.
body: Residual from the V1-1392/1324/1294 internal/tasks flakes lane (PR #918, branch claude/tasks-flakes-1392-1324-1294, head 887ad7cab, base 32c57367d; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores). PR #918 added the sweepObservationBoundKey seam for the sweep and pool-preparation observation class and fixed the tests it reproduced. Still failing under load: (1) PSR sweep family at load ~200: AllocationFence, HistoricalReplayDeadline, V0012 Expected/Pin, OwnerBarrier, AllBarrierTerminal, SuccessReplaySuccessor; the seam is available to them. (2) SURVIVORS in supervised-stage tests (CALV0089, CALV0077/0078): the supervisor drain bounds have no test seam. (3) One-off load failures: SupervisorWaitRetainsScope, CALV0089_IntegrateCheckpoint, PoolProcessDescendants, PSRCleanupAllowance. Umbrella V1-0849.
title: internal/tasks/store: remaining load-sensitive tests (PSR sweep family at load ~200, supervised-stage SURVIVORS, four one-off failures)
